source.text: ወእምድኅሬ*ዝ፡ ያስተርእይ፡ *ጻድቅ፡ ወኅሩይ፡ ቤተ፡ ማኅበሩ፡ ዚአሁ፡ እምይእዜ፡ ኢይትከልኡ፡ በስመ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: The selected causative ያስተርእይ and accusative ቤተ are rendered make the house visible, with the righteous and chosen one as singular agent. The following negative verb is plural: they will not be hindered. That plural is not silently converted to a singular house, nor is an unprinted group or a historical identification of the chosen one supplied. The starred selected constructions remain critical qualifications rather than manuscript certification.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Literal singular causative/accusative construction and following plural preserved; referent not historically reconstructed.

translation.text: After this, the righteous and chosen one will make the house of his assembly visible. From now on they will not be hindered, in the name of the Lord of Spirits.[a]
